title: Audit of a local wicking--evaporation model for saturated pool-boiling CHF on micropillar arrays
decision_or_claim: Audit whether the local continuity extension removes the global-model dry-spot singularity and identify the evidence and closure conditions required before using the model for geometry optimization.
event_definition: CHF is represented as the limiting heat flux at which the model's vapor-bubble footprint has a vanishing central dry spot or reaches the declared evaporation-limited saturation closure. This is not an independently measured CHF event definition.
system_boundary: Liquid in a homogenized micropillar layer from the nominal bubble edge to the central dry spot, with meniscus evaporation as a distributed volume sink. The external pool, vapor bubble, and heated solid provide boundary/closure conditions rather than resolved domains.

regime.description: Quasi-steady, saturated, gravity-dominated pool boiling under one axisymmetric nominal bubble on a laterally homogeneous, isotropic pillar array.

geometry_and_frame: Stationary laboratory frame with r positive from the bubble center to the bubble edge. Darcy velocity is positive outward; capillary-fed liquid velocity is negative. Diameters db and ddry define the outer and inner radial boundaries.
materials_or_fluids: Pure water at a declared saturation state for illustrative calculations
silicon or another explicitly characterized micropillar substrate

operating_conditions.name: saturation pressure
operating_conditions.range: 0.1 MPa illustrative case; pressure-specific calculations require archived property queries

initial_conditions: No transient initial condition is represented; quasi-steady balance is assumed.
boundary_conditions: P(ddry/2)=Psat-Pc for a positive dry spot

dependent_variables.name: scaled dry-spot diameter
dependent_variables.definition: Central dry-spot diameter divided by nominal bubble diameter.

governing_variables.name: radial Darcy velocity
governing_variables.definition: Depth-averaged liquid velocity in the pillar layer.

governing_variables.name: effective evaporation flux
governing_variables.definition: Footprint-normalized volumetric evaporation flux; thermal flux is rho_l h_fg j_e.

conservation_laws: Steady liquid-volume conservation in an annular control volume
Latent-energy conversion used only after the mass balance
source_and_sink_terms: Distributed evaporation sink 2 j_e/H in the depth-averaged continuity equation

constitutive_closures.name: Darcy transport
constitutive_closures.provenance: Local working manuscript and prior coupled model
constitutive_closures.calibration_boundary: K must be independently reported or computed from a declared geometry correlation

constitutive_closures.name: Uniform effective evaporation
constitutive_closures.relation: j_e is spatially uniform beneath the bubble
constitutive_closures.calibration_boundary: No literature CHF target may set j_e without disclosure

constitutive_closures.name: Bubble diameter convention
constitutive_closures.provenance: Rayleigh--Taylor neutral-wavelength convention in the working model
constitutive_closures.calibration_boundary: Do not refit db to CHF data

frame_and_invariance: The model is a stationary, gravity-aligned, axisymmetric Darcy reduction. Galilean invariance is not claimed under imposed flow because imposed flow is excluded.

ordering_parameters: spatial variation of j_e divided by its mean
scale_analysis.expected_reduction_error: Unquantified until local evaporation, permeability, and bubble-scale observations are available.

assumptions: Static contact angle is used only in the declared flat-CHF correlation and receding contact angle only in the declared evaporation closure
Intrinsic and apparent contact-angle inputs are not interchangeable without a source-specific sensitivity analysis
exclusions: global optimization claims outside closure range
baselines: Hu, Weibel, and Garimella (2019) global wicking--evaporation model
Classical hydrodynamic CHF scaling for the flat-surface contribution
calibration_boundary: No experimental CHF values are used to fit the local mass-balance equation. Contact angles, permeability, bubble scale, and evaporation closure must be declared before a forward comparison.
acceptance_criteria: R(x) tends to one as x tends to zero
R>=1 is represented only as an explicit dry-spot-free extension
falsification_cases: Measured nonzero dry spot when independently measured R exceeds one
Measured radial liquid flow that does not decline by cumulative evaporation
Geometry intervention that changes the predicted R ordering but not measured CHF or dry-area behavior
uncertainty_plan: Separate reported CHF uncertainty, source-digitization uncertainty, contact-angle uncertainty, property uncertainty, geometry tolerance, numerical root tolerance, and model-form discrepancy.
benchmark_plan: MATLAB-to-Python regression for the 12 exported Figure 2 input rows; this is implementation parity only
Source-audited literature records grouped by source, surface, coating, pressure, and laboratory; current compilation is fit-prohibited until all prediction inputs are directly supported
provenance: User-provided working manuscript and supplementary document
Hu et al. 2019 IJHMT PDF supplied locally
No unpublished numerical data are included in this package
